title: Shipping containers (sea-cans) used for storage: Division B acceptable solution or Division A alternative solution
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: April 2024 (platform created April 2, 2024, last updated April 2, 2024)

facts.text: The interpretation addresses using shipping containers for storage of materials as an acceptable solution under Division B or as an alternative solution under Division A.

Because shipping containers do not meet the prescriptive NBC(AE) requirements, the municipality may request an engineering review and plans certified by a registered engineering professional before a building permit is issued.
Storage of dangerous goods regulated by the NFC(AE) must be disclosed to the local authority having jurisdiction.
The AHJ must take into consideration the items stored in the container when setting spacing to other structures or outdoor hazards.
